svg.text: Body over the skeleton · scaly skin with larger scales on the back · about 7.9 m long
Faint grey = skeleton inside the body
MOUTH OPEN · the living animal's jaws and teeth
dental battery: hundreds of small teeth
narrow beak for plucking; tooth rows
sit far back on each side
of each jaw, 3 to 5 teeth each
fingers I to III end in hooves and carry
the weight; IV and V are small
E · LOWER LEG AND FOOT, SIDE
thick pillar leg on a soft
heel pad, toes end in blunt
4 hoofed toes on a big rounded pad
TRICERATOPS HORRIDUS · MOUTH, TEETH, HAND AND FOOT
Close-up life reference · toothless beak, 432 to 800 teeth in dental batteries, hoofed hands and feet
Faint grey = bones inside · grey fill = inside of the mouth
